precedence: This override is higher authority only for Year 6 SAT lesson access/release semantics. All non-conflicting Portal V2 authority remains binding.

ownerRequirement.rule: Year 6 SAT lessons must not inherit broad MATHS_Y6_FULL / Year 6 full-view core access. They are released lesson-by-lesson through the normal Lesson Release Import workflow.
releaseStates: LOCKED until a canonical release exists
PRELESSON_ONLY when the normal online PreLesson rule applies
FULL when the normal completed/continuing lesson release grants core access
ownerRequirement.ordinaryYear6Boundary: Normal Year 6 lessons retain existing full-library and direct-release semantics.
ownerRequirement.existingExplicitReleaseBoundary: Any SAT lesson that already has a canonical direct entitlement remains released; this change removes only broad inherited full-library access.

implementation.mechanism: Exclude canonical Y6M51..Y6M69 from full-library inheritance inside lessonAccessMap while preserving direct earned, manual, temporary and PreLesson pathways.

preservationInvariants: Do not alter normal Year 6 lesson access.
Do not alter SAT canonical IDs, display IDs, curriculum membership or resources.
Do not alter Trial session semantics, normal student sessions, protected Answer Packs, online 11+ English PreLesson VR or quiz bridge behaviour.
Student-visible completion still requires prepared access reconciliation/readback.
existingPreparedSnapshotRule: Students whose prepared access snapshot predates this change must be reconciled through the standard access publisher before the old inherited SAT FULL state disappears.
verificationMatrix: MATHS_Y6_FULL still opens an ordinary Year 6 lesson.
MATHS_Y6_FULL alone does not open Y6M51..Y6M69.
A direct canonical SAT entitlement opens that SAT lesson FULL.
A normal SAT PreLesson entitlement opens only that SAT lesson PRELESSON_ONLY.
Existing Y6MS importer mapping and state tests pass.
Shared production Worker retains all preservation gates.
